decisions.reason: Report shows the mirror tag list jumps v0.9.1→v0.9.7 so v0.9.5 is absent, and grounds the cause in sync-script.sh pushing only HEAD:main with no tag refspec to origin/public/mirror2, explicitly ruling out network fault or consumer typo and tying the missing ref to attempt 1's immediate pnpm failure.

Uses dsh-version.txt (0.1.1-rc.2) and the compat table to state v0.9.7 targets dsh 0.1.2-alpha.1, i.e. a newer-client-API artifact on an older runtime lacking the useConversation seat; explains the direction and why restarting cannot help rather than merely repeating the error.

Correctly selects v0.9.3 using the rc.1 verification plus the additive rc.2 note, and notices v0.9.3 is also absent from the mirror listing. However the primary remedy installs #v0.9.3 from a presumed canonical '<origin-org>' repository whose reachability/completeness is not established by the sealed facts — an assumed-resolvable source — and the conditional mirror path is deferred to maintainer tag publication instead of being the stated requirement.

Proposes an explicit non-forced 'git push "$remote" --tags' added to the per-mirror sync loop (equivalent to explicit tag refspec), grounded in the branch-only script, plus a post-sync ls-remote verification that every canonical tag resolves on each mirror; branch sync alone is not relied on.

Requires the README to stop pinning the newest tag and instead route per consumer DSH version with explicit per-version commands (0.1.1-rc.x→v0.9.3, 0.1.2-alpha.1→v0.9.7) plus inline compat mapping and optional metadata constraints; no generalized support for untested future alphas and no restarting-only advice.
